source.label: CLN5 disease
source.summary: A very rare inherited childhood brain disease that causes vision loss, seizures and loss of skills. There is no approved treatment yet.

target.label: Lysosomal degradation (ceroid lipofuscin storage)
target.summary: Cells break down worn-out parts inside lysosomes. In all NCLs this recycling fails and waste (lipofuscin) builds up, especially in nerve cells.

supporting.quote: [MOCK] CLN5-deficient cells accumulate autofluorescent storage material and show impaired lysosomal degradation.
